introPage.title: About CentrixG - A technology platform for optimized licensed gaming
introPage.paragraph1: At CentrixG, we believe blockbuster gaming should not be an expensive privilege. Built by technology engineers and data-minded gaming specialists, CentrixG lowers the cost barrier and brings licensed games closer to players through smart access solutions.
introPage.paragraph2: We do not follow traditional distribution paths. CentrixG is an access sharing platform that applies local data-flow coordination to help you enjoy favorite games with a highly optimized budget.
introPage.safetyIntro: To give customers confidence, CentrixG operates with strict safety principles:

safetyItems.dirtyKeys: NO dirty keys: Unlike unclear key sources that can lead to bans or revoked games, CentrixG works locally and keeps your personal account safe.
safetyItems.originalAccount: NO interference with the source account: You use your own personal Steam account to sign in and play.
safetyItems.systemRisk: NO system risk: Every solution is tested carefully so Steam protection systems can always recognize a safe state.

introPage.experienceTitle: An experience close to 95% of buying directly
introPage.experienceIntro: CentrixG technology optimizes your experience while keeping pricing competitive:

experienceItems.online: The system strictly focuses on providing games for offline play. Features requiring official server connections (online, co-op, multiplayer) may not be supported.
experienceItems.achievements: Personal achievement sync: The system recognizes and unlocks achievements directly on your Steam profile.
experienceItems.localSave: Optimized local saves: Progress is stored safely on your own computer instead of depending on Steam Cloud.

introPage.operationsBody: As a data-driven platform, CentrixG continuously checks game stability around the clock. We provide not just a product, but an automated and transparent experience from payment to setup.
